# ankra_service_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's service tokens, revoked ones included, ordered by service account. Token values are never part of the listing. Needs the `members.manage` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_service_tokens" "all" {}

# Service accounts holding no role act with read-only access.
output "accounts_without_role" {
  value = distinct([for token in data.ankra_service_tokens.all.tokens : token.account_name if token.role_slug == ""])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) Service tokens of the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Identifier of the service account the token belongs to.
- `account_name` (String) Name of the service account.
- `created_at` (String) When the token was created.
- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (UTC, as the platform renders it).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the token.
- `label` (String) Label of the token within its account.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the token last authenticated; null if never.
- `project_id` (String) Project the token is pinned to; null for an organisation-wide token.
- `project_name` (String) Name of the pinned project.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the token is revoked.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the token was revoked; null while it is live.
- `role_slug` (String) Role the service account holds; empty when it holds none and acts with read-only access.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes the token is restricted to; empty for the account's full authority.
